C0848.title: Over 6,000 Domains Used in Phishing Email Scam
C0848.summary: In May 2022, employees of Sohu received phishing emails disguised as internal notices, tricking them into scanning QR codes and logging into counterfeit pages to steal bank card numbers, ID numbers, and other sensitive information.
